subject: Astronomy & Space
title: The Cosmic Web
description: A quick win: understand The Cosmic Web.

hook.text: Zoom out far enough and galaxies form a vast web of filaments, walls, and voids stretching across the universe.

buildup.text: Galaxy clusters sit at the nodes. Thin filaments of galaxies connect them. Between them lie enormous empty voids.

discovery.text: Computer simulations predicted this pattern. Galaxy surveys confirmed it—the universe has a foam-like architecture.

twist.text: The pattern was seeded by quantum fluctuations during inflation—tiny ripples stretched to cosmic proportions.

climax.text: Mapping the cosmic web reveals how gravity, dark matter, and dark energy sculpt the universe on the largest scales.

punchline.text: A web of galaxies spanning billions of light-years. Architecture from quantum seeds.

quiz.question: What seeded the large-scale structure of the cosmic web?
options: Tiny quantum fluctuations during cosmic inflation stretched to cosmic proportions
Explosions from the first supernovae pushed matter into filaments
Dark energy carved voids into the uniform distribution of galaxies

details.summary: The cosmic web is the large-scale structure of the universe — a vast network of galaxy filaments, walls, and clusters connected by dark matter scaffolding, surrounding nearly empty voids.
details.whyItMatters: The cosmic web is the universe's skeleton. It arose from tiny density fluctuations in the Big Bang and evolved under gravity and dark energy, making it a fossil record of the universe's initial conditions and growth.
takeaways: A vast network of filaments, walls, and clusters of galaxies
Built on dark matter scaffolding surrounding empty voids
Arose from tiny density fluctuations after the Big Bang

faq.question: How was the cosmic web discovered?
faq.answer: Galaxy redshift surveys in the 1980s (like the CfA survey) mapped galaxy positions in 3D, revealing that galaxies aren't randomly distributed but cluster along filaments and walls surrounding voids.

faq.question: How does the cosmic web form?
faq.answer: From quantum density fluctuations in the very early universe, amplified by gravity over billions of years. Dark matter collapses first into halos along filaments, then gas follows, forming galaxies along these structures.
